blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — The Mandaue City Council approved a resolution seeking to augment the city’s disaster funds in preparation for the potential impacts of El Niño. Councilor Carlo Fortuna said that the additional funding would support measures to ensure adequate water supply and other emergency needs. He said that the city may need to purchase water storage containers and equipment to ensure sufficient drinking water. That need would be more pronounced in communities that could be affected by water shortages. READ ALSO: Monggos and kamote?
